name: Girlfriends In Outer Worlds
source:
In  Girlfriends In Outer Worlds, our protagonist has lost all his memories and before finishing off all the gods they save him and give him the power to travel between worlds. Our protagonist will use power to please the gods. But... power is never free...

[From [url=https://stellarkydev.itch.io/girlfriends-in-outer-worlds]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在《天外世界的女朋友》中，我们的主角失去了所有记忆，在消灭所有神灵之前，他们救了他，并赋予他穿梭于世界之间的力量。我们的主角将使用力量来取悦众神。但是……权力从来都不是免费的……

[来自[url=https://stellarkydev.itch.io/girlfriends-in-outer-worlds]Itch.io[/url]]
